title: MXenes for catalysis: current developments in photocatalysis and electrocatalysis
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01407G, Review Article
Yifan Liu, Xiuxiu Zhang, Zhenluo Yuan, Lulu An, Baozhong Liu
In recent years, MXenes have achieved remarkable progress in catalysis owing to their distinctive physicochemical properties, such as excellent electrical conductivity, tunable surface functional groups, and unique layered structures.
